notes.title: Darkzan Arena Oblivion - Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Darkzan Arena Oblivion - Update[/h1]
Get ready for a new experience filled with improvements, adjustments, and additions!  

[h3]What's New[/h3]
- 🚀 New Steam achievements and in-game achievements have been added. Show your power to everyone!  
- 🆕 Two new items added: Quiver and Scabbard.  
  - These items have unique special abilities that will expand your combat strategies.  
- 🌟 Addition of Rank Plus:  
  - Arena difficulty now scales automatically every 100 enemies defeated. Test your limits!  
- 🛡️ Physical attacks can now block and deflect projectiles and certain spells!  
- ⚡ Visual lightning effects added to arenas, increasing combat immersion.  

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
- 🎨 Re-sprites applied to several important characters for greater visual impact.  
- ☁️ Adjustments made to Steam Cloud for improved progress storage stability.  
- 🎮 Steam rich presence in the Arena updated, now showing detailed information about your game session.  
- 📦 Inventory filters added for better organization and item management.  
- 🤖 Enemy AI has been improved, making them more challenging and strategic.  
- 🕺 Player and enemy animations have been improved, providing smoother and more realistic movements.  

[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
- ✊ Physical attack collisions now push attackers back, increasing realism and impact.  
- 🛡️ Fixed the shield limit for some enemies to ensure more consistent combat behavior.  
- ⚔️ Weapon damage for certain weapons has been adjusted to achieve better balance across playstyles.  

See you in the Arena, fighters! 💥  
Prepare yourselves for new challenges and enjoy all the improvements!  

[i]MrBoscheinen[/i]

notes.title: Darkzan Arena Oblivion Patch - Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Darkzan Arena Oblivion Patch - Update Notes[/h1]  
Greetings, Arena warriors!  
The [b]Oblivion Patch[/b]   is here, bringing new challenges, improvements, and adjustments that will elevate your arena experience. Get ready to face the legendary Darkzan and explore a universe of epic possibilities. Check out the changes below:

[b]Update Highlights[/b]  
- 🔥 [b]Face Darkzan in Wave 100[/b]  
The ultimate arena challenge is finally here! Prepare to battle Darkzan and prove your worth.  

- 🎒 [b]Inventory Expansion with Backpacks[/b]  
Backpacks now increase the inventory limit, allowing you to carry more items into battle.  

- 🛠️ [b]Improvements to Forging[/b]  
Rank and Item Modifier display has been added directly to the forging screen, making the system more intuitive.  

- 🌟 [b]Improved Mastery System[/b]  
Masteries now drop every **10 enemies defeated in a row**, rewarding your skill and consistency.  

[b]New Content[/b]  
- 🛡️ [b]New Armor Effects[/b]  
Added new visual effects and bonuses to armors for greater customization and strategy.  

- 👤 [b]New Character Faces[/b]  
More face options have been added to customize your character’s appearance.  

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]  
- The arena introduction is now **skippable**, allowing you to jump straight into action.  
- A **full inventory alert** has been added to the Log and as a character voice line.  
- **Icons for equipment slots** have been added to the inventory tab for easier navigation and organization.  

[b]Balancing[/b]  
- ⚡ [b]Dash Nerfed[/b]  
Dash distance has been reduced to balance its effectiveness.  

- 🕷️ [b]More Skilled Enemies[/b]  
Enemies now have new abilities, making battles more dynamic and challenging.  

Prepare for epic battles and keep sending us your feedback! See you in the arena!  

[i]MrBoscheinen[/i]

notes.title: Oblivion Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Update Notes - Darkzan Arena Oblivion[/h1]

[b]Greetings, Challengers of Darkzan![/b]  

We’re excited to bring you a new update to [b]Darkzan Arena Oblivion[/b]. Check out the changes and improvements in this version:  

---

[h2]Fixes[/h2]  
- [b]Memory leak issue[/b]: Fixed a critical problem that could cause the game to freeze and, in rare cases, restart the computer. Your adventure is now more stable.  
- [b]Text font issues[/b]: Addressed display errors in some areas, improving the readability and overall aesthetics of the interface.  

---

[h2]Improvements[/h2]  
- [b]General performance[/b]: We’ve implemented optimizations resulting in a smoother gameplay experience, with reduced loading times and fewer FPS drops.  
- [b]Weapon and armor sprites[/b]: Some weapons and armors have received visual adjustments, making them more detailed and immersive.  

---

Thank you for all the support and feedback that help us make Darkzan Arena Oblivion even better! Get ready for new adventures and keep fighting for glory!  

MrBoscheinen
